standard.summary: full=方向+magnitude, style=magnitude only, structure=方向 only。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.full: 方向和强度都学，变化大。
optionDescriptions.style: 主要动强度/外观，骨架动得少。
optionDescriptions.structure: 主要动方向/结构，染色弱。

standard_en.summary: full = direction plus magnitude, style = magnitude only, structure = direction only.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.full: Learns both direction and strength, so it changes a lot.
optionDescriptions.style: Mostly moves strength and appearance, leaving the skeleton largely alone.
optionDescriptions.structure: Mostly moves direction and structure, with weak recolouring.

advanced.principle: full=方向+magnitude, style=magnitude only, structure=方向 only。

advanced_en.principle: full = direction + magnitude; style = magnitude only; structure = direction only.
